keywords: the goatherd and the wild goats
full_text:
A goatherd sheltered his flock in a cave during a winter storm, finding several wild goats inside. Wishing to entice the wild herd into his own flock, he fed them sweet corn, while starving his own faithful goats on dry chaff.

When the storm passed, the wild goats galloped away into the mountains.

"Ungrateful beasts!" shouted the goatherd. "I fed you choice corn, and you desert me!"

A wild goat called back: "We flee precisely because you favored us above your own flock; if new goats arrived tomorrow, you would neglect us in turn!"
moral: Do not neglect old friends to curry favor with untried strangers.
